name: Moritz Häusl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Moritz Häusl in Tirol!**

Discover the heart of the Alps in **Tirol**, where tradition meets adventure. Our cozy **Gasthof** in the charming village of **Moritz Häusl** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy pancake torn into pieces and served with powdered sugar and apricot jam. Pair it with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein** or a frothy **Bier** from the region.

Explore the stunning landscapes around **Innsbruck**, **Ötztal**, and **Zillertal**—whether hiking in the **Karwendel** or skiing on the slopes of **Axelbad**. After an active day, unwind with a relaxing **Sauna** or a warm **Gröstl** (Tyrolean fried potatoes with bacon and eggs).

At **Moritz Häusl**, every moment is a celebration of **Tirol’s** timeless beauty and warmth. **Willkommen!**
